name: JCBExpander
author: cjitter
description: Plugin expansor de audio hecho con gen~, Plugin Export y JUCE
changes:
JCBExpander v1.0.1 improves internal stability without changing the sound
or user-facing behavior: stronger sync between the parameter engine (APVTS)
and the DSP engine (Gen), safer state restoration via a single parameter
queue, and preset loading updated to use it too.
